modal_records.reference_workbook: morphing-modal/1-1 Modal Test Experiment and Numerical Results.xlsx
modal_records.reference_type: Published FEM modal frequency table, not raw nodal fields
limitations: Simple uniform/stepped plate proxy, not full morphing-wing CAD.
Material/print orientation, nominal vs measured dimensions and FEM formulation must be matched before scoring.
Specimen IDs join source CAD/table; filename flexible fraction and nominal geometry need checking; Test4 filename says fef50 although table associates Test4 with fef75.
Source README names sheets Uniform/Stepped, but actual workbook has one Modal Test Result sheet; exact cell provenance retained.
